decisions.reason: Selecting Mailreach and requiring its license for warm-up does not change the already registered campaign domain or its registrar.
The warm-up tool decision does not alter the mailbox requirement for Gmail compatibility.
Domain warm-up tooling and licensing do not change the web-forwarding destination or behavior.
Mailreach licensing for domain warm-up does not change MeetAlfred configuration or its subscription plan.
The domain warm-up tool decision does not affect Zapier configuration, plan, or add-on requirements.
Warm-up is preparatory infrastructure; choosing Mailreach does not modify the deferred automated email campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, or lifecycle.
The Mailreach warm-up decision does not change the silent-lead follow-up workflow or its cleanup constraint.
Domain email warm-up tooling is unrelated to the automated LinkedIn campaign behavior.
Choosing a domain warm-up tool does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
The Mailreach license requirement does not affect preservation of existing MeetAlfred integrations or campaigns.
The warm-up tool decision does not alter restrictions on using production leads or the preferred test identity.
Mailreach selection for domain warm-up does not change visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
